why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Get GOLDST or SILVST The vaults accept GOLDST (tokenized gold) or SILVST (tokenized silver). STRATO's guide to tokenized gold describes bridging in funds and acquiring GOLDST in the STRATO app.
2 Step 2 : Open a yield vault Go to the GOLDST yield vault or the SILVST yield vault .
3 Step 3 : Connect a wallet Select Connect Wallet to sign in, which shows your token balance and vault position.
4 Step 4 : Deposit into the vault Use the Deposit tab on the vault page. The page then shows the Reward Points per day you can earn at the current rate.
5 Step 5 : Check which positions earn The docs say the Rewards section lists which positions earn points and at what rate.
6 Step 6 : Claim points in Rewards Open Rewards and select Claim All, or claim per activity under My Active Positions.
